dev.title: Test & development
dev.aceSetupsHint: Base folder of the ACE setups (.carsetup files). Leave empty to use the default path: D:\Salvataggi\ACE\Car Setups.
dev.mockOnHint: 3 mock sessions visible in the history (R3E + ACE + AMS2, 3 laps each)
dev.mockOffHint: Adds fake sessions to the history for UI testing
dev.simulateUpdateHint: Opens the new-version prompt and simulates the download, without installing anything
dev.mockHint: When on, adds to the history an R3E session (BMW M4 GT3 - Nürburgring), an ACE one (Porsche 718 GT4 - Monza) and an AMS2 one (Formula Ultimate - Interlagos), each with 3 laps and a prefilled analysis. The R3E and ACE sessions also have the deep-dive analysis saved, the AMS2 one does not: it lets you try the "Show deep-dive analysis" button. Useful to test the UI without a real session running.
dev.telemetryHint: Writes all available telemetry (R3E and ACE) to JSONL files, one record per line. Each connection creates a new file: {{pattern}}.
